summary: Lantern Pharma Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered public offering of 1,454,175 common shares at $2.06/share, plus pre-funded warrants (exercise price $0.0001) for 681,748 shares to avoid beneficial ownership limits. A concurrent private placement includes purchase warrants for 2,135,923 shares at $2.27. Rodman Renshaw LLC acts as placement agent on a best-efforts basis with no minimum offering. This is an ordinary equity financing, not a special situation.
